interpretation.percent_change: Positive is slower; negative is faster.
interpretation.percentiles: Nearest-rank within each original window, independently recomputed from every raw complete sample. No merged windows or pooled before/after quantiles.
interpretation.noise_followup_reason: A2 public mean was materially slower than A1, and GP tail regressions remained. e/f and g/h retain further same-input observations; F's regressions remain visible. No stable whole-step benefit is established by selecting the earlier favorable runs.
interpretation.instrumentation: Root-stage and all-instance timings diagnose causes and perturb the operation. They do not replace these uninstrumented whole-step measurements.
interpretation.causal_limit: Wall/child CPU changes and process timestamps do not establish a cause for run-to-run variation.
interpretation.acceptance: No formal performance pass is claimed.
